Penta has captured championships worldwide and amassed a huge following of fans, all of whom eagerly await his arrival and greet him with his signature hand gesture. The Mexican-born Superstar embodies cero miedo every time he steps between the ropes as he thrills the crowd with his gravity-defying aerial moves and surgical striking.
